title: Dual Ended Highlighter Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Cream Formula✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A dual-ended highlighter brush that applies both cream and powder formulas with artistry-level precision.

Brush Formulation: Cream

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This two-in-one highlighter brush is inspired by PATRICK TA's technique of layering textures to maximize your glow. The fluffy side has ultra-soft bristles that seamlessly sweep powder over the high points of the face. The cream side is densely packed to diffuse the formula on top for a dewy glow.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Patrick's Technique:
-Use the fluffy end of the brush to apply powder highlighter first, then use the dense end of the brush to layer the cream formula on top.

High-Impact Shimmer:
-Use the fluffy end of the brush with powder highlighter and sweep it across the high points of the face: cheekbones, browbone, tip of the nose, and Cupid's bow.

Sheer Dewy Sheen:
-Use the dense end of the brush with cream highlighter, diffusing the formula over the high points of the face using gentle pressing motions: cheekbones, browbone, tip of the nose, and Cupid's bow.
